title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with the run_collect capability can inject attacker-controlled values into Updates data. When another user with access to the System Update Status report selects an affected row, Splunk may execute attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands with the selecting user's permissions. This occurs because the report does not validate certain input fields before using them in drilldown searches, potentially allowing unauthorized data access and modification.
